name: p5.Polar
description: A polar coordinate system library for p5.js

paragraphs: p5.Polar is a JavaScript library that extend p5.js standard drawing functions with versions using polar coordinates. The library converts polar coordinate to cartesian coordinate, and abstracts the mathematics required for making many types of geometric patterns.
